pages.text: Thirst Was Reclaimed adds a thirst bar beside hunger. It drains as you play, and with nothing to drink you eventually die of dehydration.$(br2)There is also a hidden buffer called $(thing)quenched$(), like saturation for drinks. A good drink fills it.

Water has a purity: $(item)Dirty$(), Slightly Dirty, Acceptable, Purified. Dirty water is a risk to drink. Purify it before you rely on it.$(br2)Bottles, buckets and bowls of water all carry a purity.
pages.title: Dirty water

pages.text: Boiling raises purity one step at a time. In a campfire each cook gives one step. A furnace is faster: dirty water goes straight to Acceptable, and the next cook gives Purified.$(br2)It works on water bottles, water buckets and terracotta water bowls.
pages.title: Boiling
Campfire
pages.text: Cooking water bottles, buckets and bowls here raises their purity one step per cook. Slow, but free.

pages.title: Sand Filter
pages.text: Pump dirty water in from the top, purified water out of the bottom, one step per pass. Recipe: sand over a Nozzle over a Fluid Tank.

The Sand Filter is where thirst meets Create. You build it with a $(item)Nozzle$() and a $(item)Fluid Tank$() and run it with a $(l:create_basics/fluids)pump$(/l). It is the automatic way to supply a base.
pages.title: Create filter
Terracotta Water Bowl
pages.text: A reusable bowl. Clay bowls bake into terracotta bowls, and a Spout fills one with 250 mB of water.

A Create $(item)Compacting$() recipe squeezes a Cactus into purified water (250 mB) and green dye. Good for desert bases.$(br2)Fruits Delight juices count as drinks. Farmer's Delight melon juice and apple cider hydrate like a water bottle.
pages.title: Cactus and extras

pages.text: Thirst and $(l:survival/temperature)Cold Sweat$(/l) work together. The $(l:survival/temperature_gear)Waterskin$(/l) carries a purity like a bottle, and a furnace or campfire purifies it the same way.$(br2)With Cold Sweat, thirst lost while healing follows your body temperature, not just the biome's.
pages.title: Cold Sweat
